verdict.rationale: Lighthouse is an immigration-services firm with a case-preparation platform that holds user documents, so data export and portability is a fair question to ask of it. The evidence pack documents only document uploading and case tracking, with nothing on exporting data, open formats, or offboarding. The llms.txt and OpenAPI probes both returned 404, so there is no documented programmatic export path either.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
